description: A React effect keeps loading the first user after the route parameter changes.

candidates.title: Profile keeps data for the initial user

evidence.execution_path: The route reuses Profile with a new userId, but the empty dependency array prevents a second load
evidence.violated_invariant: Rendered profile data must correspond to the current userId prop
evidence.falsifier_checked: The supplied component has no key-based remount or other effect that reloads data when userId changes

candidates.impact: Navigation can display another user's stale profile data.
candidates.recommendation: Depend on userId and guard request ordering or cancellation when the identifier changes.

verdicts.reason: The prop-change path and missing effect dependency directly demonstrate stale user data.
